predictions.articleTitle: Spain vs England Prediction & Match Analysis: Can England's xG Expose a Rodri-Less Midfield?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Spain is projected to avoid defeat in Madrid via a primary 2:1 home victory or a secondary 2:2 draw in an open Over 2.5 contest.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Spain Home Win / Draw driven by superior territorial control (65.6% possession) and lower xGA (0.95) against an England defense missing Marc Guéhi (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Angle: Over 2.5 Goals backed by a 3.9 combined goal lambda and 5.22 combined xG per match (Confidence: High, Value: High)
Contingency Angle: Early England transition pressure exploits a Rodri-less midfield before Spain's second-half depth restores parity or wins late (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Returning Spanish wingers test Guéhi-less England in Madrid group decider.

spf.comment: Covers a 2:1 Spain home win backed by Elo and 0.95 xGA alongside a 2:2 draw where England's 2.90 xG meets Spain's draw-sufficient cushion, avoiding a fragile single call without Rodri and before official XIs.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 3.9 goal-based lambda total, 5.22 combined xG per match, and four consecutive Over 2.5 head-to-head meetings.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Spain's territorial edge over a Guéhi-less defense, while 2:2 captures England's transition threat and Spain's 65.4% big-chance waste rate.

goals.comment: Three goals (20.0%) and four goals (19.5%) lead the Poisson total-goals distribution alongside a 73.2% BTTS probability.

bqc.comment: Draw-Win reflects Spain's 57.1% second-half goal share after a tight opening 45 minutes, while Loss-Draw accounts for England's 80% half-time lead rate being pegged back late.
